name: katip-kalkan
description: Mask Turkish personal data on your computer before Claude reads a document.
long_description: Why: KVKK. Client names, ID numbers and health data should not reach an AI provider. Katip opens client documents (.docx, UYAP .udf, .txt, .pdf, scans and phone photos (local OCR)) on your computer, removes names, T.C. kimlik numbers, addresses, phones, IBANs and KVKK Article 6 data locally, and gives Claude only the masked text. The placeholder map stays encrypted on your computer; restore_to_file writes the final document with real names locally, without showing them to Claude. No network access. File names are hidden too: Claude sees ids and shortened names.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List client files with ids; names that could identify a person are hidden

tools.name: mask_file
tools.description: Open a document, scan or photo on this computer and return only masked text

tools.name: write_masked_copy
tools.description: Save a masked copy next to the original

tools.name: restore_to_file
tools.description: Write the final text with real values to a local file

tools.name: forget_matter
tools.description: Delete the local placeholder map of a matter

tools.name: open_folder
tools.description: Open the Katip folder in Finder or Explorer

tools.name: katip_status
tools.description: Show engine, threshold and vault location

allowed_dir.title: Client files folder
allowed_dir.description: Katip only opens files inside this folder. Leave it as is to use Documents/katip-documents, which Katip creates for you.
